title: Decoding index blocks
statement: Let $b,D$ be natural numbers and let $e$ be a bijection from Boolean strings of length $b$ to $	ext{Fin}(D)$. For a natural number $k$ and a Boolean list, decode $k$ successive blocks of length $b$ by applying $e$ to each block, treating any positions beyond the list as false; the resulting list has length $k$.
hypotheses_covered: A bijection from Boolean strings of length $b$ to $	ext{Fin}(D)$
